# Retrieve previously cached flight results for outbound and return legs
flights = get_results_from_cache(key="flights")
return_flights = get_results_from_cache(key="return_flights")
hotels = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")

# Filter flights for outbound leg (San Jose to Portland, May 22, 2025, economy class)
outbound_flights = filter_flights(
    prior_results=flights,
    start_airport_city="San Jose",
    end_airport_city="Portland",
    departure_date=["May 22, 2025"],
    flight_class=["economy"]
)

# Filter flights for return leg (Portland to San Jose, May 25, 2025, economy class)
return_flights_filtered = filter_flights(
    prior_results=return_flights,
    start_airport_city="Portland",
    end_airport_city="San Jose",
    departure_date=["May 25, 2025"],
    flight_class=["economy"]
)

# Filter hotels for Downtown Portland, 3-star, 3 people, May 22-25, 2025
hotels_filtered = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=hotels,
    checkin_date=["May 22, 2025"],
    checkout_date=["May 25, 2025"],
    num_people=3,
    stars=[3]
)

# Check if all required results are available
if not outbound_flights.search_results or not return_flights_filtered.search_results or not hotels_filtered.search_results:
    seek_information("We need the departure date of the flight and check in and check out dates for the hotel")
else:
    # No planning needed as all results are available and meet criteria
    print("No planning needed")
